content.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי נָתַן אֹֽמֶר לְהַקְדִּישׁ קְרוּאָיו,
content.transliteration: Adonai natan omer lehaḳdish ḳeru’av,
content.english: Adonai spoke to sanctify [the people] called by Him,

content.hebrew: הֱיוֹת בְּנֵי לֵוִי לַעֲבוֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּלְמַשָּׂאָיו.
content.transliteration: Heyot benē Levi la‘avodat hammishkan ulmassa’av.
content.english: For the Levites to be [working] in the service of the Tabernacle and carrying it.

content.hebrew: רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם – לְבַד בִּצְבָאָיו.
content.transliteration: Romemot El biḡronam – levad bitsva’av.
content.english: Praises of God were in their throats—alone among His hosts.

content.hebrew: נַפְשָׁם תֶּחֱזֶה מַלְאֲכוּת אֵל וּפְלָאָיו.
content.transliteration: Nafsham teḥezē mal‘akhut El ufla’av.
content.english: They oversaw God’s work and His wonders.

content.hebrew: עַל־פִּי יוי נִפְקָֽדוּ בְּמוֹצָא הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּמוֹבָאָיו.
content.transliteration: ‘Al pi Adonai nifḳadu bemotsa hammishkan umova’av.
content.english: They were commanded by Adonai, regarding bringing the Tabernacle in and out.

content.hebrew: אֲזַי שֻׁלְּחוּ מִמַּחֲנֵה יוי טְמֵאָיו –
content.transliteration: Azai shulleḥu mimmaḥanē Adonai teme’av –
content.english: Then all impure people were sent out from Adonai’s camp—

content.hebrew: טְמֵא מֵת, וְצָרֽוּעַ, וְזָב מִתַּחֲלוּאָיו.
content.transliteration: Temē met, vetsaru’a‘ vezav mittaḥalu’av.
content.english: [Anyone] impure from corpse [contamination], or a leper, or a zav in his illness.

content.hebrew: בְּחֹק אֵל נִמְצָא חֵן לְמוֹצְאָיו.
content.transliteration: Beḥoḳ El nimtsa ḥen lemotse’av.
content.english: In accordance with God’s law, those who find Him are appreciated.

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי, הַמְגַלֶּה סוֹד אָדָם וּמַחֲבוֹאָיו –
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai hamḡallē sod adam umaḥavo’av –
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who reveals people’s secrets and hidden things?

content.hebrew: כִּי תִשְׂטֶה אֵֽשֶׁת אִישׁ לְזָר, בַּחֲטָאָיו,
content.transliteration: Ki tistē eshet ish lezar beḥata’av,
content.english: When a man’s wife strays [to lie] with a strange man, in his sins,

content.hebrew: אוֹ עָבַר עָלָיו רֽוּחַ קִנְאָה, הֲגַם אֶל מַרְאָיו,
content.transliteration: O ‘avar ‘alav ru’aḥ ḳin’a, haḡam el mar’av,
content.english: Or a jealous spirit overtakes him, even at a mere glimpse,

content.hebrew: לַהֲבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן עִם קָרְבָּנָהּ יְאָו,
content.transliteration: Lahavi’ah el hakkohen ‘im ḳorbanah ye’av,
content.english: [He should] take her to the priest, with her sacrifice that [God] desires,

content.hebrew: וּמֵי תוֹכֵחָה יַשְׁקֶֽנָּה, עִם אָלַת מִקְרָאָיו:
content.transliteration: Umē tokheḥa yashḳenna, ‘im alat miḳra’av:
content.english: And [the priest] will force her to drink waters of rebuke with the curses that he recites:

content.hebrew: אִם טְמֵאָה הִיא – יֵרָאֶה בְּבֶֽטֶן וְיָרֵךְ סוֹד הַמַּֽיִם וּמוֹרָאָיו,
content.transliteration: Im teme’a hi – yera’ē beveten veyarekh sod hammayim umora’av,
content.english: If she is impure, then the water’s fearsome secret will appear in [her] belly and thigh,

content.hebrew: וְאִם טְהוֹרָה הִיא – תֵּלֵד זֶֽרַע, אַנְשֵׁי אֵל וִירֵאָיו.
content.transliteration: Ve’im tehora hi – teled zera‘, anshē El vire’av.
content.english: And if she is pure, then she will give birth to offspring—men of God, who fear Him.

content.hebrew: כִּי יוי הֵקִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל נְזִירָיו וּנְבִיאָיו,
content.transliteration: Ki Adonai heḳim leYisra’el nezirav unvi’av,
content.english: For Adonai has raised up for Israel His Nazarites and prophets,

content.hebrew: שָׁתוּ מִמְּקוֹר אוֹרוֹ וַיֵּאֽוֹרוּ רֹאָיו.
content.transliteration: Shatu mimmeḳor oro vayye’oru ro’av.
content.english: Who drink from the fountain of His light, and, beholding Him, are enlightened.

content.hebrew: וַיַּחְנְכוּ בֵיתוֹ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאָיו.
content.transliteration: Vayyaḥnekhu veto shenem ‘asar nesi’av.
content.english: Twelve chieftains dedicated His house.

content.hebrew: מִי כְּגוֹי יִשְׂרָאֵל, חָקוּק בְּכֵס אֵל, וּצְבָאָיו?
content.transliteration: Mi keḡoy Yisra’el, ḥaḳuḳ bekhes El, utsva’av?
content.english: Who is like the Israelite nation, inscribed on God’s throne, and His army?

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ מִכָּל־בְּרוּאָיו.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki Ya‘aḳov baḥar lo Yah mikkol beru’av.
content.english: Cong. For Yah has chosen Jacob out of all His creations.

content.hebrew: חזן: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹֽרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַֽחֲרֽוֹן: (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Cantor: Listen to Me, Jacob, and Israel, who are called by Me: I am the first, and I am the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong: Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
